paragraphs: Before the shift, check cleanliness and equipment calibration. Once production begins, align optical paths and measure parameters component by component, readjusting anything outside limits. At midday, conduct batch sampling and review the yield dashboard. When anomalies appear, troubleshoot with process staff. Before leaving, clean the workstation, save data, and hand over problem batches.
